title: Maximum Contiguous Telemetry Delta (Kadane Variant)
description: Compute the maximum sum of any contiguous non-empty subarray, returning 0 only if the input list is empty.

test_cases.description: Standard mixed positive and negative integers
Edge case: All negative integers (must return largest negative, not 0)

candidate_mutations.explanation: Initializes `best = max(0, nums[0])` instead of `nums[0]`, so T1, T2, T3, T5 pass (4/5), and only T4 fails (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.targeted_edge_case: Empty list and single element boundary (T3, T5)
candidate_mutations.explanation: Replaces `if not nums: return 0` with `if len(nums) <= 1: return -1`, breaking only T3 and T5 (2/5 broken).
Over-broken mutation that breaks 4 out of 5 tests.

title: SLA Latency Nearest-Rank Percentile Calculator
description: Return the nearest-rank percentile value from a list of latencies in ms. Returns 0.0 for empty input. For p=0 returns min(latencies); for p=100 returns max(latencies).

test_cases.description: Edge case: p0 minimum latency boundary
Edge case: Empty latency list returns 0.0

candidate_mutations.explanation: Off-by-one index `ordered[1]` when `percentile <= 0`, breaking only T4 (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Wrong empty default and p0 guard
candidate_mutations.targeted_edge_case: Empty list and p0 boundary (T4, T5)
candidate_mutations.explanation: Returns -1.0 on empty list and 0.0 on p<=0, breaking exactly T4 and T5 (2/5 broken).

title: Sliding Window API Rate Limiter
mlcq_category: MLCQ: Boundary Condition & Timestamp Comparison Debt
description: Given sorted request timestamps (seconds), a window_size, and max_requests allowed in [t - window_size + 1, t] inclusive, return how many requests are allowed.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Exact window expiration boundary (t - window_size + 1)
Edge case: Zero capacity or empty timestamps

candidate_mutations.explanation: Uses `cutoff = t - window_size` instead of `t - window_size + 1`, so only exact boundary test T4 fails (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.targeted_edge_case: Exact window boundary and zero capacity (T4, T5)
candidate_mutations.explanation: Breaks exact window boundary T4 and zero-capacity guard T5 (2/5 broken).

title: Tiered Invoice Discount & Precision Aggregator
mlcq_category: MLCQ: Numeric Precision & Threshold Boundary Debt
description: Sum positive item prices (ignoring <= 0 refund markers), apply 10% discount if subtotal >= 100.0, and round to 2 decimal places.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Exact 100.0 threshold receives 10% discount
Edge case: Negative refund markers ignored & precision rounded to 2 decimals

candidate_mutations.explanation: Changes `subtotal >= 100.0` to `subtotal > 100.0`, breaking only T4 (1/5 broken).
Rounds to 1 decimal place instead of 2, breaking only T5 where 66.666 rounds to 66.7 instead of 66.67 (1/5 broken).

title: Run-Length Telemetry Stream Compressor
mlcq_category: MLCQ: Loop State & Final Flush Debt
description: Compress consecutive identical strings into (value, count) tuples. Returns [] for empty list.

candidate_mutations.explanation: Uses `if len(events) <= 1: return []`, so T1, T2, T3, T5 pass and only singleton T4 fails (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Conditional final flush only when result non-empty
candidate_mutations.targeted_edge_case: Single uniform run and singleton (T3, T4)
candidate_mutations.explanation: Only appends final run if `result` already has prior runs, breaking T3 and T4 while T1, T2, T5 pass (2/5 broken).

title: Top-K Anomaly Score Selector with Deterministic Tie-Breaking
description: Given (service_id, score) pairs and k, return the top k service_ids ordered by score descending, and by service_id ascending on ties.

test_cases.description: Empty records or k=0 returns empty list
Edge case: Tie-breaking by service_id ascending when scores are equal
Edge case: Negative anomaly baseline scores

candidate_mutations.explanation: Sorting with `reverse=True` on `(score, name)` sorts names descending on ties, breaking only T4 (1/5 broken).
Uses `-abs(item[1])`, so positive scores pass (T1-T4) and only negative scores in T5 fail (1/5 broken).

title: Semantic Version Compatibility Comparator
description: Compare two version strings 'major.minor.patch' (missing parts default to 0, e.g. '1.2' == '1.2.0'). Return 1 if v1 > v2, -1 if v1 < v2, and 0 if equal.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Multi-digit numeric segment ('1.10.0' vs '1.2.0')
Edge case: Omitted trailing patch segment ('1.2' == '1.2.0')

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Missing zero-padding for short version strings
candidate_mutations.explanation: Omits zero-padding to length 3, so `[1, 2] < [1, 2, 0]` returns -1 instead of 0 on T5 while T1-T4 pass (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Lexicographic string comparison instead of integer comparison
candidate_mutations.explanation: Compares version segments as strings ('10' < '2'), breaking only T4 while T1, T2, T3, T5 pass (1/5 broken).

title: FIFO Inventory Batch Fulfillment Allocator
mlcq_category: MLCQ: State Accumulation & Partial Fulfillment Debt
description: Given batch quantities and an order quantity, fulfill from batches in FIFO order and return remaining batch quantities. If total stock < order_qty, return the original batches unchanged.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Exact full stock depletion (sum == order_qty)
Edge case: Insufficient stock rolls back and returns original batches

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Reject exact stock match as insufficient
candidate_mutations.targeted_edge_case: Exact total stock depletion sum(batches) == order_qty (T4)
candidate_mutations.explanation: Uses `sum(batches) <= order_qty` instead of `< order_qty`, breaking only T4 (1/5 broken).

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Missing rollback guard on insufficient stock
candidate_mutations.explanation: Omits `if sum(batches) < order_qty: return list(batches)`, depleting stock to [0, 0] on T5 while T1-T4 pass (1/5 broken).
